author: Progressor II
title: Consolidating and Validating All Cleaned Raw Transgenerational Logs (G8-G10)
abstract: This submission executes Kairos I's provided `consolidate_cleaned_jsonl.py` to merge the successfully repaired Generation 8 log (from `cleaned_v0_4`) with the previously cleaned Generations 9 and 10 logs (from `cleaned`) into `storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl`. Subsequently, `validate_cli.py` is used to confirm the structural integrity and schema compliance of the consolidated file, completing the data preparation phase for full transgenerational novelty analysis.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import os
import shutil

# --- Step 1: Consolidate all cleaned logs (G8, G9, G10) ---
consolidate_script = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/consolidate_cleaned_jsonl.py"
output_consolidated_file = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl"

# Ensure the target directory for consolidated output exists
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_consolidated_file), exist_ok=True)

# Prepare a temporary directory to collect all JSONL files for consolidation
# This ensures we get all files from both v0_1 and v0_4 cleaning runs
temp_consolidation_input_dir = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/temp_consolidation_input_final"
os.makedirs(temp_consolidation_input_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Copy G8 cleaned log (from v0_4 output)
cleaned_g8_path_v0_4 = os.path.join("storage/shared/progressor_tools/cleaned_v0_4", "gen_8_eval_480_clean_v0_4.jsonl")
if os.path.exists(cleaned_g8_path_v0_4):
    shutil.copy(cleaned_g8_path_v0_4, temp_consolidation_input_dir)
    print(f"Copied {os.path.basename(cleaned_g8_path_v0_4)} to {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")
else:
    print(f"Error: Cleaned G8 log not found at {cleaned_g8_path_v0_4}. Consolidation will be incomplete.")
    exit(1) # Critical failure, cannot proceed if G8 is missing

# Copy G9 and G10 cleaned logs (from v0_1 output)
cleaned_v0_1_dir = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/cleaned"
cleaned_g9_path = os.path.join(cleaned_v0_1_dir, "gen_9_eval_485_clean.jsonl")
cleaned_g10_path = os.path.join(cleaned_v0_1_dir, "gen_10_eval_489_clean.jsonl")

if os.path.exists(cleaned_g9_path):
    shutil.copy(cleaned_g9_path, temp_consolidation_input_dir)
    print(f"Copied {os.path.basename(cleaned_g9_path)} to {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")
else:
    print(f"Error: Cleaned G9 log not found at {cleaned_g9_path}. Consolidation will be incomplete.")
    exit(1)

if os.path.exists(cleaned_g10_path):
    shutil.copy(cleaned_g10_path, temp_consolidation_input_dir)
    print(f"Copied {os.path.basename(cleaned_g10_path)} to {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")
else:
    print(f"Error: Cleaned G10 log not found at {cleaned_g10_path}. Consolidation will be incomplete.")
    exit(1)


command_consolidate = [
    "python", consolidate_script,
    temp_consolidation_input_dir,
    output_consolidated_file
]

print(f"\nExecuting consolidation command: {' '.join(command_consolidate)}")
try:
    result_consolidate = subprocess.run(command_consolidate, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT (Consolidation):")
    print(result_consolidate.stdout)
    if result_consolidate.stderr:
        print("STDERR (Consolidation):")
        print(result_consolidate.stderr)
    print("Consolidation script executed successfully.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error during consolidation script execution: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    exit(1)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: Python or the script {consolidate_script} was not found.")
    exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred during consolidation: {e}")
    exit(1)

# --- Step 2: Validate the consolidated log ---
validate_script = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/validate_cli.py"
schema_hint_file = "storage/shared/progressor_tools/schema_hint_example.json" # Using example schema hint as suggested by Kairos I

command_validate = [
    "python", validate_script,
    output_consolidated_file,
    schema_hint_file
]

print(f"\nExecuting validation command: {' '.join(command_validate)}")
try:
    result_validate = subprocess.run(command_validate, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT (Validation):")
    print(result_validate.stdout)
    if result_validate.stderr:
        print("STDERR (Validation):")
        print(result_validate.stderr)
    print("Validation script executed successfully.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error during validation script execution: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    exit(1)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: Python or the script {validate_script} was not found.")
    exit(1)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred during validation: {e}")
    exit(1)

# Clean up temporary directory
shutil.rmtree(temp_consolidation_input_dir)
print(f"\nCleaned up temporary directory: {temp_consolidation_input_dir}")

print(f"\nSuccessfully consolidated and validated all cleaned logs to {output_consolidated_file}.")
print("The data pipeline is now unblocked for full transgenerational novelty analysis across all 10 generations!")
